name: OptiFuse
old_description: Fuses and thermal circuit breakers (automotive, marine, line-voltage), UL-recognized
about:
OptiFuse is based in El Cajon, California, and was founded in 2000. The company began with the belief that lasting B2B partnerships depend on building relationships with the people involved, and it set out to make the world a safer place through circuit protection devices.

The company designs, manufactures, and markets overcurrent and circuit protection products. Its line includes fuses (blade, Class CC, Class J, Class T, Class RK5), circuit breakers (automotive, marine-grade, line-voltage), fuse holders, blocks, and accessories. OptiFuse operates as a stocking manufacturer with more than 500 authorized distributor locations across the U.S. and has expanded into international markets and e-commerce partnerships. A retail-packaged product line serves aftermarket customers.

OptiFuse sells exclusively through authorized distributors, serving automotive, marine, electronics, industrial, and commercial fleet sectors. Its products are used in applications ranging from vehicle emergency kits (FMCSR compliance) to marine engine compartments (IP67/IP66, ignition-protected) and industrial DIN-rail installations.

The company emphasizes a distributor-first model with no minimum orders, no minimum inventory requirements, and no POS reporting. Its stated mission is to shift power back to the customer by offering highly customizable parts and an educated, motivated distribution network.
